name: Dom Dolla
description:
'''Dominic Louis Matheson''' (born 18 January 1992), better known by his stage name '''Dom Dolla''', is an Australian tech house producer, DJ, songwriter and remixer, acclaimed for his special house music style and high-profile collaborations. He has been nominated eight times for the [[ARIA Award for Best Dance Release]]; Including: in 2017 for "Be Randy", with [[Torren Foot]] and in 2019, for the song "[[Take It]]". He won the award at the [[2020 ARIA Music Awards]] for the song "[[San Frandisco]]" and in 2023 for the song "[[Rhyme Dust]]" (with MK). He was a [[66th Annual Grammy Awards|Grammy Award]] nominee in 2024 for the song "[[New Gold (song)|New Gold]]" featuring [[Gorillaz]], [[Tame Impala]] and [[Bootie Brown]], and a [[Juno Awards of 2024|Juno Award]] nominee in 2024 for the song "[[Eat Your Man]]" featuring [[Nelly Furtado]].

He has performed in festivals such as [[Coachella 2022]] and [[Lollapalooza|Lollapalooza 2023]]. Dom has sold out such venues as [[Red Rocks Amphitheatre]] in [[Denver]], [[Colorado]], [[Sidney Myer Music Bowl]] in [[Melbourne]], [[Australia]] and [[West Side Tennis Club|Forest Hills Stadium]] in [[New York City|New York]].

In December 2025, Dom Dolla performed in front of 40,000 at Sydney's [[Sydney Football Stadium (2022)|Allianz Stadium]], becoming the first electronic act to headline an Australian stadium show.
